reviews.title: It's cute, it's round and it works great!
reviews.comment: I think this mic has great sound, great levels, nice tone. Plug and play, very easy to use.  You just have to make sure you have the mic stand or boom set up that fits this very weirdly shaped, but lovely mic.  This is my second purchase of Blue mics.  Love it.

reviews.title: This is the coolest, budget mic you can find.
reviews.comment: Honestly, I liked the design of this mic so much, this was the reason why I picked it. It was $22, so it's absolutely worth it. The build quality is great, it doesn't feel cheap at all. The sound quality is good, my voice sounds crystal clear. The only problem was that the seller sent me the wrong cable. The mic has a USB type B port, and they sent me a mini USB cable.
reviews.author: Xavy

reviews.title: Very good for older tech.
reviews.comment: Got a gently used like new one and am very pleased. Overall the sound quality is good and you can always fix the small problems in your editor. So far I have used this very easily through plugging it into my MacBook via an adapter. It has helped me with several voiceovers on pretty large production projects. I plan on using this for a podcast in the future as well.
reviews.author: Sammie K
